# fMP4 golden vectors: init segments, prft boxes, the fragments a
# FragmentWriter writes and the records a Segmenter writes, all as hex.
# tests/golden.rs computes each from the inputs named here and the unit
# script it defines. STRIMS_GOLDEN=update rewrites the outputs.
#
# init: tracks v (H.264, 90 kHz), a (AAC, 48 kHz) or va, and the
# composition delay in nanoseconds.
init tracks=v delay_ns=0 
init tracks=va delay_ns=0 
init tracks=va delay_ns=66666666 
init tracks=a delay_ns=30000000000000 
#
# prft: track, media time and publish time in Unix milliseconds.
prft track=1 media_time=6000 unix_ms=0 hex=0000002070726674010000010000000183aa7e80000000000000000000001770
prft track=2 media_time=4294967296 unix_ms=1793275200250 hex=00000020707266740100000100000002ee8db3c0400000000000000100000000
#
# fragments: the script through a FragmentWriter of the span, flushed.
fragments span=0 
fragments span=100ms 
fragments span=max 
#
# records: the script through a Segmenter of the span into a VecSink,
# finished; each record's hex, comma-separated.
records span=0 ,
records span=100ms ,
records span=max ,
